channel.title: Zone4 - air fryer buying guides
channel.description: Question-shaped air fryer buying guides built only from figures read off official product pages. Every number carries its source; no price or star rating is published.

item.title: First-Air-Fryer Checklist: 7 Numbers to Check Before You Buy
item.description: Capacity, counter depth, width, height, cavity layout, heat range and cleanup: the seven numbers to check on any air fryer listing before you buy, with the three products on this site as worked examples.

item.title: Air Fryer Sizes Explained: 6QT vs 8QT vs 26QT - What Fits Your Counter
item.description: Quarts, liters and counter depth: what the listed sizes of a 6-quart dual basket, an 8-quart single basket and a 26-quart French-door oven actually mean, with every figure linked to its source.

item.title: Holiday 2026 Air Fryer Gift Guide: Match the Format to the Counter
item.description: A gift guide built from listed specifications only: which air fryer format suits which cook, why it carries no prices, and the one measurement to take before you wrap the box.

item.title: Chefman 6-Quart Dual-Basket Air Fryer: Spec Check, Sizes and Sync Finish
item.description: Two independent 3-quart baskets, a 200-450°F digital range and easy-view windows: what the Chefman 6-quart dual-basket lists, who it fits, and every figure linked to its source.

item.title: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French-Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven: Spec Check and Fit
item.description: French doors, a dual-speed fan and rotisserie, 24.6 liters listed: what the 26QT Emeril Lagasse oven brings to a countertop, what it asks from your counter, and every figure traced to its source.

item.title: Chefman 8-Quart TurboFry 4-in-1 Air Fryer: Spec Check and Size Fit
item.description: Four presets, a 200-400°F range and a 450°F Hi-Fry option: the Chefman 8-quart single-basket air fryer's listed numbers, who it suits, and a source link behind every one.

item.title: Dual-Basket vs Single-Basket vs Toaster-Oven Air Fryers: Compared
item.description: Three countertop air-fryer formats compared on listed capacity, footprint and features - units kept exactly as listed, blank cells explained, and every figure traced to its official source.

item.title: How to Choose an Air Fryer in 2026: the Format-First Method
item.description: A five-step decision guide to choosing between a dual-basket air fryer, a single-basket fryer and a French-door toaster oven - using only listed specifications that trace to their official sources.
